verdict.rationale: Terraform's core model applies changes to many resources at once. It builds a dependency graph and parallelizes creation and modification of non-dependent resources (terraform-gh-1). A single `apply` can run unattended with `-auto-approve`, and `-destroy` plans removal of all remote objects (terraform-docs-17, terraform-docs-45). The `import` block can bring in multiple resources at a time (terraform-docs-64), and `for_each` drives multi-item configuration (terraform-comm-5). Missing for 10: first-party docs on `for_each`/`count` bulk patterns in the pack, and evidence that large-scale state refactors are safe (users describe bulk `state mv` merges across hundreds of resources as risky, terraform-comm-14).
